My teaching and training materials emphasize reproducible empirical analysis and applied econometric methods.

## Topics

- Applied econometrics
- Time-series analysis and vector autoregressions
- International economics with empirical applications
- Working with economic data in R

## Course materials

Course resources will be added to [Materials](materials.qmd). Materials can be linked as HTML presentations, Quarto source files, data, or reproducible R scripts.
